title: PaymentIntent
description: Canonical ERC-4337 EIP-712 Typed Data Payment Intent Schema for Bastion X v2.3

chainId.description: EVM Chain ID (e.g. 31337 for local Anvil)

verifyingAccount.description: Checksummed address of the BastionAccount smart contract

accountNonce.description: Replay protection nonce tracked on-chain by BastionAccount

policyVersion.description: Active policy epoch; incremented on policy updates and guardian rotations

actorSession.description: Session identifier string for the delegated agent key

approvalTier.description: Hardware approval tier selected via RFID card

targetContract.description: Target contract to invoke (typically tokenAddress for payments)

amountBaseUnits.description: Payment amount in token base units (e.g. 200 * 10^6 for 200 bUSD)

maxPerTxException.description: Explicit per-transaction ceiling authorized for this exception

deadline.description: Unix timestamp expiration deadline for the exception

calldataHash.description: Keccak256 hash of the exact ABI-encoded call payload
